messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Loan Approval Process.
New loan applications arrive every 10 minutes on average (exponential inter-arrival distribution).
Steps:
1. Receive Application - service task, fixed 2 minutes, no resource needed.
2. Credit Check - service task, normal distribution mean 15 min std 3 min,
   performed by Credit Analyst. 2 Credit Analysts available.
3. Review Decision - exclusive gateway:
   - 70%: Approved -> Prepare Offer
   - 30%: Rejected -> Send Rejection
4. Prepare Offer - user task, uniform 10-20 min, Loan Officer (1 available).
5. Send Rejection - service task, fixed 5 min, no resource.
Both paths end at: Application Closed. Simulate for 8 hours.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

      <outgoing>Flow_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <serviceTask id="Task_ReceiveApplication" name="Receive Application">
      <incoming>Flow_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_2</outgoing>
    </serviceTask>

    <serviceTask id="Task_CreditCheck" name="Credit Check">
      <incoming>Flow_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_3</outgoing>
    </serviceTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewDecision" name="Review Decision">
      <incoming>Flow_3</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_Approved</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_Rejected</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <userTask id="Task_PrepareOffer" name="Prepare Offer">
      <incoming>Flow_Approved</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_4</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <serviceTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send Rejection">
      <incoming>Flow_Rejected</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_5</outgoing>
    </serviceTask>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge" name="Merge">
      <incoming>Flow_4</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_5</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_6</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Application Closed">
      <incoming>Flow_6</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplication" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApplication" targetRef="Task_CreditCheck" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreditCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved (70%)" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareOffer">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">approved == true</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected (30%)" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">approved == false</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Merge" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Gateway_Merge" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

  </process>

  <!-- Simulation Configuration (QBP-style extension, for BIMP/other simulators) -->
  <qbp:processSimulationInfo id="SimInfo_1" processId="LoanApprovalProcess"

    <qbp:timetables>
      <qbp:timetable id="Timetable_Default" name="24/7" default="true">
        <qbp:rules>
          <qbp:rule fromTime="00:00:00" toTime="23:59:59" fromWeekDay="MONDAY" toWeekDay="SUNDAY"/>
        </qbp:rules>
      </qbp:timetable>
    </qbp:timetables>

    <qbp:resources>
      <qbp:resource id="Resource_CreditAnalyst" name="Credit Analyst" totalAmount="2" costPerHour="0" timetableId="Timetable_Default"/>
      <qbp:resource id="Resource_LoanOfficer" name="Loan Officer" totalAmount="1" costPerHour="0" timetableId="Timetable_Default"/>
    </qbp:resources>

    <qbp:elements>
      <qbp:element elementId="Task_ReceiveApplication">
        <qbp:durationDistribution type="FIXED" arg1="120" timeUnit="seconds"/>
        <qbp:resourceIds/>
      </qbp:element>

      <qbp:element elementId="Task_CreditCheck">
        <qbp:durationDistribution type="NORMAL" mean="900" arg1="180" timeUnit="seconds"/>
        <qbp:resourceIds>

      <qbp:element elementId="Task_PrepareOffer">

        <qbp:resourceIds>
          <qbp:resourceId>Resource_LoanOfficer</qbp:resourceId>
        </qbp:resourceIds>
      </qbp:element>

      <qbp:element elementId="Task_SendRejection">
        <qbp:durationDistribution type="FIXED" arg1="300" timeUnit="seconds"/>
        <qbp:resourceIds/>
      </qbp:element>
    </qbp:elements>

    <qbp:sequenceFlows>
      <qbp:sequenceFlow elementId="Flow_Approved" executionProbability="0.7"/>
      <qbp:sequenceFlow elementId="Flow_Rejected" executionProbability="0.3"/>
    </qbp:sequenceFlows>

    <qbp:simulationDuration value="28800" timeUnit="seconds"/>

  </qbp:processSimulationInfo>
